decision.accepted_edge: The index alone can never establish an edge. It may identify one exact previously unrepresented official economic source for a separately frozen one-use source gate.
decision.adjudication_rule: Parse only titles, descriptions, and URLs offline. Deduplicate every apparent mechanism against the registry. Do not use index snippets as payout, eligibility, fee, account, execution, or profitability evidence.

limitations: Search discovery already exposed overview labels for an open Referral Program, a coming-soon Refer-a-Friend program, and an application-only Market Maker Program; those snippets are ineligible for promotion.
An index title, description, access label, or link is not a complete current economic contract or positive payout floor.
No linked page, incentive API, price, BBO, book, fee endpoint, account, credential, application, referral, order, deposit, fund movement, or transaction is authorized.
question: Does the complete current official Polymarket US documentation index identify a genuinely distinct deterministic cash-flow, rebate, collateral, referral, or execution-right mechanism outside the registry?
retry_policy: This exact official index GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP, empty-response, phrase, or schema failure and do not retry an HTML or locale alias. If successful, inventory the retained index offline once, open at most one exact previously unrepresented economic source under a fresh frozen contract, and stop before market or account access. Reopen the index only after its retained response hash is independently known to have materially changed.
